text:
evan: Heads-up: partner roadmap huddle notes — cloud providers called about rack power rebalancing next quarter which may change H100/H200 usable slots by region. We need a coordinated plan for marketplace waves, SI demos, and joint press. Short meeting summary here.
meera: Is this uniform across all vendors or specific to certain SKU families?
vendor_nvidia: Nvidia: impact is concentrated on H200 blade configs in dense racks; estimate 8-12% effective capacity reduction in impacted zones. H100 less affected but still a small bump in thermals.
vendor_amd: AMD: MI300 partner-preview microcode next week; early tests show mixed impact depending on memory config, range ~5-9%. We'll publish partner-test images.
olga: Gaudi update?
vendor_amd: Habana/Gaudi stable, minor driver tweak will land; not blocking.
samir: Proposed high-level policy: 1) Wave announces by region (us-east -> eu-west -> apac) 2) Mark SKUs with a short-status badge and a hover tooltip (not hide) 3) SI demos proceed internally but external scheduled with a 72h cushion for press + partner updates.
kai: Ops: can we make a simple region gating CSV that product/marketplace can consume? Something like: ```region,sku,status,expected_fix_date,notes
us-east,H200,constrained,2025-05-12,"vendor microcode pending"
eu-west,MI300,provisional,2025-05-14,"partner-preview image scheduled"```
ev an: Perfect. Legal/Marketing: what buffers do you need?
meera: Legal wants a 48h approval window for partner note edits; Marketing requests 72h for press embargo. We should default to 72h for any public-facing press.
vendor_nvidia: We'll try to accelerate validation but ask partners to avoid public claims until we confirm post-image metrics.
olga: Product leaning: publish "availability" and tag perf as "provisional". But include clear measured deltas link. Avoid retracts.
samir: SI teams: please mark any customer-facing demos that depend on H200 perf for latency SLOs. If customers have reserved slots we need to send a targeted notice and offer to move to a different region or to MI300 pools where possible.
kai: I'll add routing rules: if H200 derate >10% then long-context models (>6k tokens) route to MI300 where available; otherwise use B200 with throttling. I'll formalize as routing-policy:v2.
deploy-bot: perf-sweep scheduled: job#9001 staging-us-east-1 images: nvidia/h200:canary, amd/mi300:preview, habana/gaudi:2.7. Will post results to /internal/hw-perf/job9001.csv ETA 6h.
meera: Partnerships to draft partner note template. Include: measured delta, test config, impacted regions, expected fix ETA, recommended customer mitigations.
ev an: Let's also attach a simple customer email snippet for sales to use. Example: "Your reserved H200 slots in us-east-1 may see small perf variance; we can offer migration to MI300 pools while vendors validate firmware"
vendor_amd: We'll upload preview images and test configs to partner-bucket and ping this thread.
vendor_nvidia: Sending compat matrix and a short partner-only note by EOD.
olga: Action items: Kai (ops) create gating CSV + routing-policy PR. Meera (legal/partnerships) draft partner note + sales snippet. Evan (product) add SKU badge + banner text in marketplace UI. Engineers run perf sweep and post CSV. Vendors to upload images. Reconvene after job#9001 CSV posted or on vendor ETA change.
samir: If perf derate ends up >12% in a region and vendor fix ETA >72h we switch to a staggered announce for that region and notify marketing + sales to pause press.
ev an: Thanks all. Keeping this thread live for updates. :wave:
